params.q: What is the UPI transaction limit per day?

search_parameters.q: What is the UPI transaction limit per day?

response.markdown:
The standard UPI transaction limit per day is **₹1,00,000 (₹1 lakh)** for most users, set by NPCI. This cap applies across all UPI apps combined and covers both P2P (person-to-person) and P2M (person-to-merchant) payments. [0] [1] [2] [3]

Higher limits apply for specific categories:

| Category | Per-transaction limit | Daily aggregate limit |
|---|---|---|
| P2P & standard P2M | ₹1 lakh | ₹1 lakh |
| Capital markets, insurance, travel, collections, GeM | ₹5 lakh | ₹10 lakh |
| Credit card bill payments | ₹5 lakh | ₹6 lakh |
| IPO / RBI Retail Direct | ₹5 lakh | ₹5 lakh |

Additionally, most banks allow up to **20 P2P transactions per day**. [4] [3] [5] Your actual limit may be lower depending on your bank's individual policies. [4]
